name: rsi-skill
description: Recursive self-improvement for Agent Skills: generates fresh eval cases every iteration, runs the target skill headless in sandboxes, grades findings, promotes a challenger only on held-out evidence, and stops on goal, budget, plateau or an unreachable goal.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate and improve a skill until a goal is met
interface.longDescription: Profiles a target Agent Skill, writes a measurable goal, then iterates: fresh eval cases each iteration, headless sandboxed runs, deterministic checks plus evidence-based grading, an improver that can edit anything in the skill, and a champion/challenger gate judged on held-out cases. Stops on goal, limits, plateau or an unreachable goal.
defaultPrompt: Run rsi-skill against ../my-skill until no major problems, max 3 iterations, $20.
